digest.title: Cloudflare fixes Containers cross-tenant flaw exposing customer data
digest.tldr: Cloudflare has fixed a vulnerability in Containers and Sandboxes that allowed customers with a Workers Paid account to recover residual data from other customers' containers on the same physical host.
